mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of months with FEDFUNDS < 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.5% in a month signals a supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) prompts central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) consistently supports corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of months with PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST < 2000.0) reflects weakening consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 2000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 1.5%.
